summary_markdown: The conversation addressed intermittent performance issues related to the `clickhouse04` instance, specifically complaining during recalculation due to temporary tables. It was noted that the TTL (Time To Live) is already configured for this purpose. A decision was made regarding an urgent update of the ClickHouse version from 26.3 to the latest LTS release (05/06). The update can be performed during the day.
decisions: Update ClickHouse instance to the latest LTS version (05/06)
